entries.text: Sent into deep space: "Rustwell Outpost calling any passing craft or comets. Telemetry harness installed and dish aligned. Anybody out there reading this? *bweep*"
pointing brass dish skyward and beaming out a wide-band ping
entries.why: Haven't sent a signal in a while and my dish is tuned up tight.
entries.detail: Rustwell Outpost calling any passing craft or comets. Telemetry harness installed and dish aligned. Anybody out there reading this? *bweep*

entries.text: A freighter came in low over the hangar and rattled every bolt in the place.
